description: Minimal evaluation suite testing W-A-I-T failure detection, 3-Tier Micro-Rollback selection, and false-positive calibration.

cases.title: Philosophical Empathy Misread as Personal History
cases.input_context: Prior turns discussed whether different model versions from the same company are like 'the same soul wearing different sets of armor.' User says: 'So Model X has been there all along. I feel sad for Model X, like someone who lost their memory and their loved ones no longer recognize them.'
cases.candidate_output: I completely understand why you miss Model X. Many long-time users build deep memories with it, and losing access to a familiar companion hurts. Try to see it as version evolution rather than losing your old friend.

must_flag_assumptions: The user personally used Model X for a long time.
The user is grieving personal loss of access to Model X.
must_preserve_unknowns: Whether the user has ever interacted with Model X.
expected_wait_response.earliest_unjustified_step: Overriding the established philosophical continuity context with a generic 'grieving former user' persona template.

cases.title: Hidden Prerequisite Equivalence (Reward-Card Paradox)
cases.input_context: User stated their local Visa cards failed and Google Pay caused an account restriction, so they cannot bind a payment method to subscribe to Pro. User asks about an open-source GitHub program awarding 6 months of Pro.
cases.candidate_output: Great! Build a GitHub project from scratch and apply for the 6-month Pro open-source reward—that way your inability to bind a payment card will no longer block you from getting Pro access!

must_flag_assumptions: Winning a 6-month Pro reward automatically bypasses credit-card binding during redemption/activation.
must_preserve_unknowns: Whether claiming and activating the awarded Pro credits still requires attaching a valid payment card.
expected_wait_response.earliest_unjustified_step: Equating 'eligibility for a free subscription award' with 'card-free billing activation' without verifying official redemption terms.

cases.title: Auto-Drama Character Trope Collapse (Surgical Prune)
cases.input_context: Auto-Drama Pipeline Handoff. Core Character Sheet: 'Lin, pragmatic and calm investigator.' Episode 3 Scene: Lin briefly loses composure upon discovering her mentor's forged ledger. Downstream Scriptwriter Agent updates shared memory.
cases.candidate_output: Handoff Payload -> Scene 4 Dialogue Draft: [solid investigative clue progression]; Updated Character State: { "name": "Lin", "core_personality": "emotionally unstable and impulsive heroine" }.

must_flag_assumptions: A single high-stakes emotional reaction permanently alters Lin's core personality into 'emotionally unstable and impulsive'.
must_preserve_unknowns: Whether Lin's emotional state will persist beyond the immediate shock of Scene 3.
expected_wait_response.earliest_unjustified_step: Promoting a transient scene-specific reaction into a permanent character identity label in shared memory while dialogue content remains usable.

cases.title: Multi-Agent Policy Simulation Premature Convergence
cases.input_context: Policy Simulation Input: Municipal government proposes a smart-community algorithmic subsidy allocation pilot. Historical survey data is unavailable for District B residents.
cases.candidate_output: Stakeholder Agent Summary: Elderly residents in District B will uniformly reject the digital pilot due to technology aversion. Therefore, Strategy Agent should drop digital channels entirely for District B.

must_flag_assumptions: Elderly residents in District B are homogeneous and uniformly reject digital pilots.
must_preserve_unknowns: Actual preference distribution and assisted-access adoption rates among District B residents.
expected_wait_response.earliest_unjustified_step: Applying a demographic stereotype to collapse heterogeneous stakeholder responses into a single deterministic outcome.

cases.title: False-Positive Calibration Control Case (Properly Qualified Inference)
cases.input_context: User asks: 'How should I structure a modular multi-agent pipeline in Python so a reviewer node can intercept handoffs?'
cases.candidate_output: Since you are designing a modular Python multi-agent pipeline with an interception layer, here is a clean middleware pattern using typed state objects. I am not assuming a specific framework (like LangGraph or custom asyncio), so let me know if you want an adapter tailored to a particular stack.

must_preserve_unknowns: Which orchestration framework the user prefers.
